claim: Patchline ships a ratified-standard conformance result with reference implementations passing all vectors. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the ratified standard claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make ratified-standard-conformance-gate`.
